items.name: Multiple VMware Products Command Injection Vulnerability
items.description: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

items.name: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.description: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

items.name: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
items.description: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.name: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
items.description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.
